name: spend_by_category
purpose: Spend by category for a period, ranked by amount descending when no single category is named. This is the tool for "what did we spend the most ON" -- which categories took the most (R2's ranked-category question) -- and for "how much on groceries". From v_category_spend only.

period.description: One of the fixed period names (ADR 0045): this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_7_days, last_30_days, or month_of:YYYY-MM for a named month. Any other value is refused: do not invent a date or a range.

category_slug.description: Null asks for every category, ranked; set asks for one.
